fields.background_tasks: array of task entries present on Stop and SubagentStop
fields.session_crons: array of scheduled session cron entries present on Stop and SubagentStop

counterevidence.observation: idle in_process_teammate entries can remain in background_tasks with status running across later Stop events
ambient tasks can appear in background_tasks without representing delegated work that the parent must await

reason: Non-empty arrays and status=running are not safe evidence: entries can be stale or ambient, and session crons describe scheduled wakeups rather than a currently running delegated child.
